requirements: Host supplies immutable read-only DTOs from its verified installed/enabled registry
No private data, credentials, arbitrary file paths or opaque capability tokens
Denied caller receives a generic authorization error before any registry lookup
Host rechecks installed/enabled state, manifest digest and caller authorization
Host controls navigation and user confirmation; untrusted iframe user-gesture claims are not proof
Reject stale expectedVersion, unknown/disabled/non-game targets without leaking private metadata
Never accept caller-supplied URL, code, source path, tokens or another extension data

publisherTrust: Manifest publisher string and file hashes are not proof of publisher identity; host must use reviewed install/trust records
backwardCompatibility: Older manifests without classification remain app/[] and do not enter games inventory. Older hosts reject newly added classification fields until upgraded.
